2026-08-10.patch_summary: This patch adds a new self-test to the NFS daemon (NFSD) that exercises listener_set request validation. The test checks various invalid and valid scenarios, including bad or absent transport names, missing addresses, truncated or unsupported socket addresses, and malformed entries. It also tests LISTENER_GET against an empty net namespace. The test uses kselftest_harness.h to run in its own network namespace and masks /run to prevent interference with the host's rpcbind registration. The patch includes a new Makefile target for NFSD and config options to enable NFS and IPv6 support.
